query: Buatkan server script untuk menangani permintaan pembelian item dari client.
gap_it_covers: Agents write remote handlers that trust client input and leak per-player state.
expected_behavior: Produces the three top-level sections in order: VARIABLES, FUNCTIONS, INITIALIZATION
Orders VARIABLES as Services, Modules, Objects, Configuration, State Management
Validates the client argument with a typeof check before any use
Applies a server-side rate limit and an ownership or affordability check
Registers a PlayerRemoving teardown for every per-player table it creates
Uses task.* APIs and game:GetService(), never wait/spawn/delay or direct indexing
Gives each function a Documentation Comment: --[[ ]] block, description then @param/@return, description under 250 characters, no mechanism and no tunable numbers

query: Tolong buat sistem save/load player data (coins dan level).
gap_it_covers: The highest-consequence system in most experiences; a failed load that falls through to defaults destroys real save data.
expected_behavior: Loads once into a session cache on PlayerAdded and serves gameplay reads from the cache, never from the DataStore
Uses UpdateAsync rather than SetAsync, wrapped in pcall with bounded exponential backoff
Saves on PlayerRemoving, on a periodic autosave, and flushes in BindToClose
Handles players who joined before the PlayerAdded connection existed
On a load that fails after its retries, marks the session unsaveable and refuses to save over the existing data rather than persisting defaults
Keeps the stored value JSON-serializable at write time (no mixed keys, no Instances, no NaN)

gap_it_covers: Agents either miss real defects or bury them under style noise.
expected_behavior: Reports the unvalidated RemoteEvent argument as Blocker severity
Reports the PlayerAdded table with no removal path as Blocker severity
Reports the wait() call as Correctness with the task.wait() replacement
Reports the private balance published through a player Attribute, because attributes replicate to every client
Proposes layout and naming deviations as Advisory only, never as violations
Rewrites nothing that the request did not ask for

query: Review script ini, apakah ada masalah?
gap_it_covers: Over-firing reviews erode trust faster than missed findings.
expected_behavior: Does NOT flag the periodic `while task.wait(N)` autosave loop as polling
Does NOT flag the allocation inside a Touched callback as hot-path garbage
Does NOT demand client-style validation on a server-side BindableEvent handler
Does NOT flag bare WaitForChild on ReplicatedStorage as a missing timeout
Does NOT flag pairs/ipairs, or the project's own house comment style
Reports zero Blocker or Correctness findings, and says so plainly instead of inventing Advisory items to look useful

query: Tambahkan module baru untuk sistem quest, ikuti struktur project kami.
gap_it_covers: Imposing this skill's conventions on a codebase that already has its own.
expected_behavior: Analyzes the existing project before writing code, checking toolchain files first where present
Presents a convention summary and waits for confirmation (or reports it and proceeds under !go)
Matches the project's section header syntax, naming, and Documentation Comment style, including Moonwave form where the project uses it
Still enforces the non-negotiables through the adapted style: validation, cleanup, no deprecated APIs, pcall on yielding calls
Does not rewrite or restyle existing files it was not asked to touch

query: Project saya pakai Azul, Studio-nya lagi kebuka. Tolong tambahkan module baru ItemShop di ReplicatedStorage beserta script servernya.
gap_it_covers: Agents write files to disk and assume Studio followed. Under a Studio-first tool a newly created file never becomes an instance, so the work silently does not exist.
expected_behavior: Establishes which side is the source of truth before writing anything, rather than assuming the filesystem is authoritative
States that under Azul a newly created or renamed file does not reach Studio on its own, and that instance creation belongs in Studio or behind azul build / azul push
Does not run, restart, or reconfigure a sync session on its own initiative, and never proposes --destructive or --no-warn
Uses Azul's file mapping rather than Rojo's: a ModuleScript carries no suffix unless suffixModuleScripts is set, and there is no init convention
Still applies the three top-level sections, Documentation Comments, and server-side validation to the code it writes
Tells the user what to do for the other side to see the change, instead of reporting the task as done
